findings.title: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
findings.vulnerability_full_name: Apache Log4j2 JNDI LDAP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
findings.description: Apache Log4j2 <=2.14.1 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Segera lakukan upgrade pustaka Apache Log4j ke versi 2.15.0 atau yang lebih baru, atau nonaktifkan fitur JNDI lookup.

findings.title: Spring Framework Data Binding Remote Code Execution (Spring4Shell)
findings.vulnerability_full_name: Spring Framework Data Binding RCE via ClassLoader Manipulation
findings.description: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution (RCE) via data binding under specific class loader conditions.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Spring Framework ke versi 5.3.18+ atau 5.2.20+, atau perbarui versi Java runtime.

findings.title: Fortinet FortiOS Path Traversal Vulnerability
findings.vulnerability_full_name: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Path Traversal and Arbitrary File Read
findings.description: A path traversal vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN allows an unauthenticated attacker to download system files via crafted HTTP requests.
findings.recommendation: Terapkan patch resmi dari Fortinet atau nonaktifkan layanan SSL VPN yang tidak terproteksi.
